hinweis: Descriptive post-run review of our own small-stake live runs of the mentions bot. Reconstructed read-only from the run logs; resolutions from public Gamma data. Stakes/shares are log estimates: where the FAK order status returned no fill price, the price cap is assumed, which overstates the stake. Cash truth per event is the curated wallet reconciliation (wallet_netto_usd). No trading recommendation, no return forecast.
